packs.label: Vector Tactical
packs.description: Precise transients, controlled tails, and strong material contrast. The safest fit for the current control-room art.

cues.label: Pulse Bolt
cues.description: The default shot: fast, readable, and light enough to repeat.

cues.label: Phase Needle
cues.description: A precise high-speed projectile with a surgical transient.

cues.label: Cinder Disc
cues.description: A weightier launch with heat, grit, and a wider tail.

cues.label: Bot Impact
cues.description: Confirms damage without competing with the projectile identity.

cues.label: Wall Impact
cues.description: Duller and less rewarding than striking a bot.

cues.label: Bot Destroyed
cues.description: A compact mechanical collapse rather than a giant explosion.

cues.label: Zone Secured
cues.description: A restrained upward cue for a meaningful control change.

cues.label: Countdown / Start
cues.description: Three preparation ticks and a clean systems-live cue.

cues.label: Match Won
cues.description: A short result stinger suitable for repeated ranked games.

cues.label: Reward Unlocked
cues.description: The richest cue, timed for the accomplishment toast.
